faq_heading: 1 bedroom condos in Chilliwack: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a 1 bedroom condo cost in Chilliwack?
faq.a: Of the 1 bedroom condos in Chilliwack, 82 sold over the past year at a median of $332,450, with the middle half between $251,000 and $399,500.

faq.q: How long does a 1 bedroom condo take to sell in Chilliwack?
faq.a: The median was 28 days, and homes sold for 96.5% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which Chilliwack neighbourhood has the most 1 bedroom condos sales?
faq.a: Chilliwack Proper South, with 18 of the 82 sales at a median of $381,200.

faq.q: Which buildings in Chilliwack have 1 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Mountainview Lane (12 sales, median $403,000); Andmar (5 sales, median $411,910); Birch Street Properties (3 sales); Newmark (3 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 1 bedroom condo in Chilliwack?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 1 bedroom condos that sold in Chilliwack was $294 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 1 bedroom condos in Chilliwack compare
A 1 bedroom condo in Chilliwack sold for $50,550 less at the median than a 2 bedroom one ($332,450 against $383,000, 139 sales). The strata fee was $294 a month against $412.
Of the 7 cities with 1 bedroom condo pages, Chilliwack has the second lowest median price. Abbotsford is lowest at $324,950 and South Surrey highest at $485,000.
